name: charge_dust_trail
for: Bell Warden 'charge' and Bandit Chief 'bull rush' (side.rs Motion::Charge)
notes: A looping trail at the feet of a charging boss: a rolling plume of dust streaming back (-x) and rising a little, a low skid plume, grit kicked back that bounces, and fine ground streaks. Export faces +x (the charger moves +x and the dust trails to the left); mirror when charging left. Attach it to the boss's feet for the whole charge. Built at Bell Warden density (181 px / 3.4 m; the Chief is 55). 12-frame seamless loop @ 12 fps.
